wins: Identified initial foothold vector through web application reconnaissance, enabling controlled access to user-level shell (ep001_step03).
Completed scoped credential harvesting and validated privilege separation boundaries before attempting escalations (ep001_step07).
fails: Failed to progress beyond user context due to ineffective privilege escalation strategy and lack of local exploit tuning (ep001_step11).
No successful post-exploitation actions completed, leading to 0% success rate despite multiple recon cycles (ep001_step15).
key_outcomes.summary: Strong recon and foothold establishment but repeated stops at privilege escalation prevented mission success; focus next on tailored local exploit discovery and execution.

repeated_failure_patterns.pattern: Privilege escalation attempts stall because kernel/local exploit discovery wasn’t followed by validation or version-specific tuning.

skill_cards.if_condition: When SSH port 22 is open and banner indicates OpenSSH ≤8.2
skill_cards.then_action: Run targeted SSH enumeration with nmap and searchsploit to identify user misconfigurations

skill_cards.if_condition: When user shell is acquired and sudo -l returns commands without password
skill_cards.then_action: Enumerate sudo binaries and match to known exploits; validate with GTFOBins or local SUID checks

skill_cards.if_condition: When privilege escalation target (kernel or service) version is identified
skill_cards.then_action: Search for public exploits (searchsploit, ExploitDB) and test via controlled payload

memory_ops.reason: Consistent success in initial SSH enumeration and banner parsing informs reconnaissance phase.

next_experiments.title: Local service privilege escalation triage
next_experiments.description: Automate version extraction for running services, map to CVEs, and apply safe proof-of-concept payloads to confirm exploitability.

next_experiments.title: Sudo enumeration & validation workflow
next_experiments.description: Integrate sudo -l parsing with GTFOBins automation to quickly identify passwordless escalation paths and harden verification steps.

next_experiments.title: Exploit validation harness
next_experiments.description: Set up reproducible test harness for candidate exploits (searchsploit-backed) so each escalation attempt documents expected output and failure reason.
